confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Phuket pricing, not checked against live listings or venue prices. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation varies a lot by area (Patong versus Old Town or Rawai) and by season, so the hostel and hotel anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the usual local price relationship to beer (roughly 2.5 to 3 times the beer price) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation was not verified on rba.gov.au in this session. It comes from a third-party site that republishes RBA data and reports the 16 October 2026 value, so confirm it against the official RBA F11 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Thai beach resort towns with similar tourism pricing, such as Krabi and Koh Samui, adjusted for Phuket's tourist-area premium. Accommodation is also informed by the typical tier structure of Thai resort-town guesthouses and mid-range hotels in July, which is low season.
